verdict.rationale: No cart or checkout-session API is documented. The closest analogues are the purchase-intent mandate (POST /acp/v1/instructions, which can be created and cancelled) and the Agent Toolkit/MCP tools that let agents "create and manage" invoices and payment links. These are payment-authorization and billing objects rather than true cart or order drafts, so they cover the story only glancingly. Missing for 10: a documented cart/order-draft create and update call with line items, an explicit update operation on order contents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
